description: Does UN peacekeeping work? Naissance, réussites, échecs (Rwanda, Srebrenica, Liban) et vocabulaire.

questions.question: Where and when was UN peacekeeping born?
questions.explication: 1948 : observateurs de l'ONU (UNTSO) pour surveiller l'armistice entre Israël et ses voisins arabes.

questions.question: How many peacekeeping missions have there been since the start of the UN?
Roughly how many people serve in UN peacekeeping today?
questions.explication: Environ 70 000 en 2024, un peu plus de 50 000 en 2026 après les coupes budgétaires — le chiffre de la vidéo dépend de sa date.

questions.question: In how many missions do peacekeepers serve today?
What have peacekeeping missions helped achieve? (plusieurs réponses)
choix: supporting the transition from war to peace
questions.explication: Les réussites mises en avant par la vidéo.

questions.question: In which countries did peacekeeping help restore stability? (plusieurs réponses)
questions.explication: Exemples souvent cités de missions réussies (aussi Namibie, Mozambique, Timor-Leste…).

questions.question: Which genocide did UN peacekeeping fail to prevent in 1994?
questions.explication: Rwanda, 1994 : environ 800 000 morts malgré la présence de la MINUAR.

questions.question: Which massacre took place in 1995 despite UN peacekeepers?
questions.explication: Srebrenica, juillet 1995 : 8 000 hommes et garçons bosniaques tués dans une « zone de sécurité » de l'ONU.

questions.question: After the Hamas attacks of October 7, 2023, where did peacekeeping fail to prevent an escalation between Hezbollah and Israel?
In spite of uncertainties in Gaza and Ukraine, do member states remain supportive of peacekeeping?
choix: No, they want to abolish it
questions.explication: Les États membres continuent de soutenir le maintien de la paix.

questions.question: UN peacekeeping was born in the ___ East in 1948.
Peacekeeping failed to prevent the 1994 ___ genocide.
Peacekeepers could not stop the 1995 ___ massacre.
UN peacekeepers are known as the Blue ___.
Peacekeeping missions help the transition from ___ to peace.
Does UN peacekeeping work? (bilan)
questions.verso: Achievements: 70+ missions since 1948, lives saved, civilians protected, stability restored (Liberia, Sierra Leone, Côte d'Ivoire, Cambodia…). Failures: Rwanda 1994, Srebrenica 1995, Lebanon after Oct. 7, 2023. Limits: mandates depend on the Security Council, lack of funding and troops, consent of the parties.

questions.question: Caricature (Waza Africa) sur les Casques bleus
questions.verso: A woman tells a peacekeeper: « Thanks to you, the situation is dramatic. Without you, the situation would be tragic. » → ironie : les Casques bleus ne règlent pas tout, mais sans eux ce serait pire.
